thread:
maria: Hey support — our dev demo started hitting 429s for the US‑east free trial account. They clicked upgrade in the UI but billing shows \"pending\" and tokens are exhausted. Repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_KEY>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"model\":\"small-chat\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"hello\"}]}' -> 429 with body: {\"error\":\"rate_limit_exceeded\",\"retry_after\":30}. Need a temporary uplift or a replay/backfill option for ~2 hours so the demo can continue. Pinned logs/screenshots attached.

support_bot: Automated notice: account acct_7X9 has hit the free-tier daily cap. Burst limiter triggered (see docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits). Headers typically: x-rate-limit-limit, x-rate-limit-remaining, x-rate-limit-reset.

alex: Can you paste the full response headers (x-rate-limit-*, x-request-id) and the billing txn id? We can manually apply a temporary cap raise if payments are stuck.

maria: Headers from the response: x-rate-limit-limit: 600, x-rate-limit-remaining: 0, x-rate-limit-reset: 1947654400, x-request-id: rq_9b2. Billing txn id: tx_000123 — payment shows \"processing\" in Stripe dashboard. They attempted upgrade ~3m before the 429s.

sarah: I've flagged payments team to check webhook replays; if payment is still pending we cannot auto-provision the paid quota. Sales can request a short bridge exception.

sales_liz: I can approve a 24h temporary quota bridge for acct_7X9 while payments clear, provided legal signs off. Need expected QPS and tokens/day estimate to size the lift. @maria roughly how many tokens/sec and bursts? :thinking_face: 

maria: During the demo we peaked ~8 rps sustained for ~10 minutes; overall ~200k tokens in 30m because each demo runs multi-turn conversations. We can throttle client to 5 rps if needed.

miguel: Ops can apply a soft lift for 2 hours if approved. Command we use internally:
```
PATCH /admin/accounts/acct_7X9/quota
Body: { \"temporary_quota\": 500000 }
```
Ping me once you confirm the order id so we annotate the exception.

alex: For reproducibility please include the minimal repro snippet (masking the key) and exact timestamps of the failing requests. Also include the `x-request-id` from a failing response so we can trace in logs. Suggest exponential backoff parsing of `x-rate-limit-reset`.

maria: Added masked curl and screenshot of the billing modal (shows \"processing\"). Demo restarts at 14:00 PT — we need the temporary lift before then.

sales_liz: Approved on my side; legal has given a one-time exception. @miguel you have go-ahead. :white_check_mark:

miguel: Done — temporary_quota applied for acct_7X9 (500k tokens). Propagation may take ~2 minutes. Logged incident INC-3942 and noted sales approval.

maria: Verified — demo back online, no 429s observed. Thank you! Please follow up with payments team to ensure webhook retry and to confirm the paid upgrade goes through; we don't want recurring manual bridges. :rocket:

alex: I'll open a postmortem ticket for payments + webhook retries and add a checklist for demo flows (webhook idempotency, payment status check before provisioning). Assigning to @payments_team. Closing this thread.
